in_greek.name: Αϊλέη
in_greek.meaning: Το Αϊλέη σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο Κύριός μου'

data.spiritual_significance: The name Ailee carries deep spiritual significance in different traditions. In Greek mythology, Aileos was the name of a god associated with the sea and sailors, who was believed to provide protection and guidance to those at sea. Thus, the name Ailee can be seen as a reminder of the presence and guidance of a divine power, especially in times of uncertainty or difficulty. In the Christian faith, the image of a calm and steadfast wave during a storm can be seen as a metaphor for faith and trust in God during challenging times. Therefore, the name Ailee holds a spiritual significance that encourages faith, hope, and trust in the divine power of God.
